title: Scoped theorem: sharp excess-rank budgets for exact overcomplete E8 decoders
body:
For an exact all-pairs E8 decoder with `m` terms, the two factors' ranks outside the live root code satisfy **s+t <= m-8**. This package proves the complete feasible region, constructs every feasible pair with every term active, and derives the full rank-one residual form for two-sided ten-term decoders. It also proves the symmetric-factor distinction: real symmetric decoders stay in the root code; complex symmetric decoders can have residual rank up to `floor((m-8)/2)`, subject to ambient dimension.

The proof applies standard rank algebra and isotropic cancellation. The contribution is a sharp decoder-specific constraint and parameterization extending joaqcoo's #1224 projection equations and nine-term dichotomy. It does not claim priority for the known existence of a two-sided ten-term decoder.

Only `research/decoder-excess-rank/` is added. `PROOF.md` is the universal written argument. The exact P112 witness has copy bill **82**, rising to **90** under an identity-preserving orthogonal term gauge; this records why the parameterization cannot be treated as a cost-preserving search normalization.

## Verification

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/decoder-excess-rank
```

Passed locally on macOS 27.0.1 arm64 / Python 3.12.13 in about 59 seconds:

- 168 general and 32 symmetric complex examples, every feasible residual-rank choice for 8–14 terms on P112/P120; all terms active; 2,694,400 exact identity entries.
- Gaussian-rational and separate integer-realification rank computations; four extracted ten-term residual forms; ten mathematical/source controls.
- A standalone integer checker, importing neither the primary checker nor predecessor code, verifies the stored symmetric witness, its nonzero rank-one residual, ordinary-versus-Hermitian distinction and both copy invoices.
- Six regression groups, including a 256-matrix determinant oracle, each ten-term obligation, witness/source corruptions, and optimized read-only relocation. Regression groups also passed under optimized Python 3.14.6.
- Package metadata/source pins, selected-result integrity and staged whitespace checks passed.

These are implementations by the same assisted author. Independent human review, Lean formalization, selected-construction cold replay and native supplier admission are unclaimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Scope, sources and coordination

Started from main `ee055dc44815497927ef618fc985b93c2dcbda2a`; submission base `0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2`, contribution head `652264fa1f70820139b2730363a0056b7fadc689`. Guidance, catalogue, selected record and live inputs were unchanged by the intervening main update. SOURCES.json retains exact Git/blob/SHA-256 bindings; no frozen source or selected frontier changes.

The revision-3 `complex-rank-shape-decoder` card is explicitly marked **changed scope** to this algebraic side result. Residual rank is not recursive child rank. No cheaper decoder, complete physical invoice, 5% construction-gate success or new kappa is claimed. The README and TASK identify the remaining support-aware ten-term P112 search and its blockers.

Final overlap refresh covered 741 open PRs and 267 discussion records with complete reported pagination and no warnings, plus local notes/ledger. This does not establish novelty. [Claim and final handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1622).

Credit joaqcoo/#1224, woklerx/#1077, themilkman216/#968, Philipp/mightyOil/#1197 (including the prior gauge/copy-cost warning), Sagar Thakrar/#1327, DreamingOfClouds/#717/#446, Douglas Colkitt/#1240 and Arham Tahir/#1605. Exact overlapping heads and evidence boundaries are retained in the package.

Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in proof, implementation, verification and writing. No subagents. Apache-2.0.
